description: This file defines the SummaryDisplayField entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_summary_display_field' database table. It includes properties for various display and sorting attributes and relationships to other entities.

classes.name: SummaryDisplayField
classes.description: An ORM entity representing a summary display field configuration within the OrangeHRM application, with properties for label, function, sorting options, and display settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SummaryDisplayField object, particularly setting up the collection for associated SelectedGroupField entities.
